'''Bravo Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] that underwent training on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. They were selected as potential [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] candidates by ARC [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] after they successfully ran the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]].

==Training==
[[File:BravoSquadCadetFires-CC.png|thumb|left|A Bravo Squad cadet fires his training blaster.]]
{{Quote|Let's start with the unit that ran the practice test in record time. ARC trooper time.|Colt|<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>}}
All of the members were clones of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], that were born on the planet Kamino to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the Clone Wars they were fighting in their last practice tests under the supervision of [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] and the [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]]. The members of Bravo Squad perfected the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]], running it in, as ARC Commander Colt called the practice test, ARC Trooper time.
